checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Eyes, nose, mouth, jaw and proportions look very close to the source.
Visible freckles, pores and natural texture remain; no airbrushing or de-aging.

must.item: Curly dark hair and expression recognisable
must.why: Curls and the subtle closed-mouth smile are preserved; hair is slightly wispier at the edges.

must.item: Casual sweater replaced with professional outfit
must.why: Charcoal blazer over a white top.

must.item: Park replaced with unobtrusive backdrop and flattering lighting
must.why: Plain light-grey backdrop with soft, even light.

faults.what: The skin looks slightly cleaner and more detailed, and the face is a touch sharper than the source. This is subtle and the identity holds.
Stray flyaway hair strands at the edges look slightly different from the source.

summary: The edit keeps her face, skin texture, curls and expression, and swaps in a charcoal blazer with a white top on a plain grey backdrop, with only minor differences from the source.
